name: Khai niem va quy tac giao thong
description: Khai niem co ban va quy tac tham gia giao thong duong bo.

name: Nghiep vu van tai
description: Kien thuc ve nghiep vu van tai va kinh doanh van tai.

name: Van hoa giao thong va dao duc nguoi lai xe
description: Van hoa ung xu, dao duc nghe nghiep va phong chong tac hai ruou bia.

name: Ky thuat lai xe
description: Ky thuat dieu khien xe va xu ly tinh huong.

name: Cau tao va sua chua xe
description: Kien thuc co ban ve cau tao, bao duong va sua chua xe.

name: He thong bien bao duong bo
description: Bien bao cam, nguy hiem, hieu lenh, chi dan va bien phu.

name: Sa hinh va xu ly tinh huong
description: Thu tu xe di, tinh huong giao nhau va quy tac uu tien.
